staking.title: Simple Staking.
staking.description: Delegating is the smartest way to hold ONE. You help secure the network and earn compound interest on your crypto assets without technical headaches.
staking.bullet2: Rewards paid mainly in ONE tokens
staking.bullet4: Full transparency on fees and performance
staking.step1Desc: Use MetaMask. Connect to Harmony Mainnet Shard 0 via chainlist.org.
staking.step2Desc: You can buy ONE tokens on practically any CEX or DEX.
staking.step3Desc: Visit the staking dashboard and confirm your delegation.

about.title: Championing Harmony

about.desc2: We believe that a strong blockchain needs a loud voice. Our continuous social presence helps drive adoption and keeps the community informed.
about.tweetContent: Proud to support the #HarmonyONE ecosystem! 💙🌿 Consistently validating blocks and spreading the word since the beginning. Together we build a sustainable future. 🚀
